user.description: Adds the SmartWings quirk to Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) for WM25/L-Z shades, and tells you when ZHA has not applied it. If ZHA is already running, SmartWings reloads it once, so your Zigbee devices are unavailable for a few seconds. Set each shade's limits with its remote: the shade stops at them for Home Assistant too.

abort.zha_not_configured: Set up the Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) integration first.

zha_not_ready.message: Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) is not set up.

quirk_not_loaded.title: SmartWings quirk not loaded
quirk_not_loaded.description:
Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) did not apply the SmartWings quirk to these shades, even after SmartWings reloaded ZHA:

{shades}

Without it, ZHA uses another quirk, which swaps the Open and Close commands for these shades and lacks the SmartWings fixes.

Another quirk for these shades probably takes precedence, such as a file in your ZHA custom quirks folder. Remove that quirk, then restart Home Assistant.

quirk_now_upstream.title: The SmartWings quirk is now part of Home Assistant
quirk_now_upstream.description: The Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) quirks that come with Home Assistant now include the SmartWings quirk, so SmartWings no longer adds its own. You can remove the SmartWings integration (Settings → Devices & services → SmartWings → ⋮ → Delete), then restart Home Assistant.
